description: Keeps the Zest auth session fresh at Codex session and prompt boundaries.

hooks.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Zest: Node >= 22.13 required. Install from https://nodejs.org" >&2; exit 1; fi; _zv=$(node --version); _zmaj=${_zv%%.*}; _zmaj=${_zmaj#v}; _zrest=${_zv#*.}; _zmin=${_zrest%%.*}; if [ "$_zmaj" -lt 22 ] 2>/dev/null || { [ "$_zmaj" -eq 22 ] && [ "$_zmin" -lt 13 ]; } 2>/dev/null; then echo "Zest: Node >= 22.13 required. Install from https://nodejs.org" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec node "$HOME/.codex/plugins/cache/zest/zest/0.1.7/dist/hooks/refresh-auth.js" SessionStart'
